create_nixl_connector_worker: create a NixlConnectorWorker instance with vllm_config, engine_id, and kv_cache_config for distributed KV transfer
register_kv_caches: register KV cache tensors with NIXL for distributed memory transfer between workers
start_load_kv: start loading KV blocks from a remote engine by triggering non-blocking NIXL transfers
get_finished: get requests that are done sending or receiving on this worker for scheduler tracking
shutdown: shutdown the NIXL connector worker releasing all transfer handles, agents, and registered memory
